sources.name: AI Hygiene Inspector - Manage Readiness for Confluence
sources.provenance: Named in the owner's brief. Listing URL search-reported 2026-10-01 (vendor Lumito lab; v4.2.0 of 2026-03-16). A search summary said it addresses 'contradictions, duplicates and outdated content', but the listing text it quoted lists stubs, outdated and orphaned pages: whether the listing itself says 'contradiction' is unverified.

sources.name: Better Content Archiving and Analytics for Confluence
sources.provenance: Named in the owner's brief. Listing URL search-reported 2026-10-01 (vendor Midori Global Consulting; content lifecycle management, archiving, analytics). No contradiction claim was found in search summaries.

sources.name: Evergreen AI for Confluence
sources.provenance: Named in the owner's brief and in GATE-S4's kill clause.
sources.note: NOT LOCATED. Three web searches on 2026-10-01 found no Marketplace listing with this name; the nearest hits were FreshPage (which has an 'evergreen' content tag) and Better Content Archiving (which supports 'evergreen' pages). This source watches the Marketplace search results for the name. When a listing appears, or the owner supplies its exact URL, change kind to marketplace-listing and set urls. Until then the kill clause cannot be evaluated.

sources.name: Atlassian Cloud changes (release notes blog)
sources.provenance: Atlassian's weekly 'Atlassian Cloud changes' posts (an example post URL, search-reported 2026-10-01: https://confluence.atlassian.com/cloud/blog/2026/04/atlassian-cloud-changes-apr-13-to-apr-20-2026). The index URL is a guess; the first run will say.

sources.name: Atlassian guide: Automate your content workflow with Confluence and Rovo
sources.provenance: Atlassian's own positioning of Rovo for content upkeep. URL search-reported 2026-10-01. Search summaries describe a Rovo 'Documentation Agent' that reviews pages for staleness and proposes rewrites; no Atlassian page was readable here to confirm.

sources.name: K-AI Document Knowledge Platform
sources.provenance: NOT in the owner's brief. Found 2026-10-01: its own pages (search-reported) say it 'continuously detects contradictions, duplicates, obsolescence' and 'detects conflicts in real time', with a Confluence integration. A vendor that claims contradiction detection is a material finding for the differentiation thesis; whether its Confluence integration works at change time is unverified.

sources.name: FreshPage: Trusted Knowledge for Confluence
sources.provenance: Lead, off by default. Trust and freshness banners, review policies and an 'evergreen' content tag; search-reported $13.97 a month for 11 or more users, free up to 10. Probably what 'Evergreen' in the brief gestures at; not a contradiction tool as far as search says.

sources.name: evergreen.team (unchecked lead)
sources.provenance: Lead, off by default. Appeared in a web search for 'Evergreen AI Confluence' on 2026-10-01; nothing is known about what it is, and it may be unrelated.
